entries.name: SPCA (HK) Animal Emergency Hotline (out-of-hours vet emergencies)
entries.duty: Hotline on standby 24 hours a day, every day. Call first; do not go to a centre expecting a vet on duty. For true emergencies only; out-of-hours vet care is usually at the Hong Kong Centre.
entries.note: Page also says all private vets provide a 24-hour emergency service. Page lists poisoning among conditions needing immediate treatment but offers no poison-advice line.

duty_i18n.es: Línea de atención disponible las 24 horas, todos los días. Llama antes; no vayas a un centro esperando encontrar un veterinario de guardia. Solo para urgencias reales; la atención veterinaria fuera de horario suele ser en el Hong Kong Centre.

notes: Run 2026-11-11. WebFetch only worked for URLs surfaced by web search results (provenance); official sites hkva.org.hk, afcd.gov.hk and cityu.edu.hk could not be fetched directly (provenance block); hkva.org homepage and AFCD/pets.gov.hk PDF were opened. HK Veterinary Council (vsbhk.org.hk) register only lists names, not opened. No animal poison information line found (SPCA hotline page gives no poisoning-specific service); none listed. Phone numbers in the AFCD PDF and some aggregator/group pages are misaligned, so only phones from clinics' own pages were used. Not covered: ~150 further small-animal clinics in AFCD list (names/addresses only, no verified phone/url); Pets Central addresses missing; AMC Fanling/Ma On Shan/Tung Chung and Pet Space Discovery Bay/Tung Chung skipped because their page phone numbers conflicted with other sources. Right-to-private: no reviews included.
